problems.problem: The rounded-rectangle card inset with a soft drop shadow at the canvas edges survives from the previous version (visible in image 1 as a framed plate over a darker violet surround). The declared concept is a seamless full-bleed printed card whose step rings expand from the exact centre; the frame adds a second, unrelated device and crops the outermost step ring, so the field reads as a bordered mat rather than an infinite fresnel stair.

Faint circular halo arcs still contaminate the rectangular step system: the contact-detail crop (image 6) shows a soft circular curve dipping beneath the glass base between y≈940-1010, and matching arc banding is visible in the lilac field left of the bottle. The concept demands hard-edge rectangular steps with clean 90-degree corners; these residual circles blur the flat-printed side of the dimensional paradox.

The gold seam is now correctly rectangular but is rendered as a solid opaque gold block (shapes entry at x=300,y=425, 480x460, opacity 0.9) sitting behind the bottle's right flank and cap. A 'thin seam line' reading as a filled plaque flattens the cap silhouette against it and over-weights the right mid-field, fighting the even ink-light of the concept.

The plaque band still mixes axes: 'PRADA' is centered at x=481 (bbox 421-548) and the gold rule is centered at x=540 (356+367/2), while the 110px 'Paradoxe' is left-aligned from x=162 leaving a dead zone right of x=586. Three different centers make the band read as stacked leftovers instead of one composed lockup, unlike the confident single-axis plaques in references 3 and 5.

The 'PRADA' logotype remains the forced dark-brown correction ink (#261E16) at only 28px with 8px tracking; against the 110px title it is visually negligible, and its muddy brown sits outside the declared palette (#8a5fa8, #f4eef8, #d8b45e), so the plaque top lacks a chosen, palette-true ink.

changes.value: Seamless full-bleed flat matte screen-printed card in medium orchid violet edge to edge, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, six crisp hard-edge concentric rectangular step rings in lighter lilac expanding from the exact centre of the frame like fresnel lens steps with clean 90-degree corners, one thin straight-edged rectangular gold outline seam aligned to the third step, no circles, no arcs, no rounded card border, no frame, no drop shadow, no vignette, no texture gradients, no objects
